prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: design-review concept image for the existing Korean writing cafe "쓰는 인간"; proposal only, not an actual implemented app screenshot.
Edit target: the supplied actual Flutter cafe entrance screenshot. Preserve the current camera angle, rectangular room dimensions, all walls and window locations, left garden-facing windows, right bookshelf location, rear coffee counter, back left arched quiet writing seat, and the large six-person longitudinal central table. Preserve approved mocha brown stone floor, warm oak tables, walnut frames, warm ivory lime plaster, brass pendant lights. Do not enlarge the room or add furniture that narrows walking routes.
Primary request: show one restrained, feasible AFTER-WORK WRITING mood proposal as a single cohesive image. Maintain recognizable simple stylized 3D rendering quality from the actual screenshot: no photoreal fantasy, no luxurious new architecture, no raytraced-looking materials. Keep the current furniture count and composition.
Targeted changes: subtly lower diffuse light on the large foreground floor and ceiling, retain safe visible circulation, concentrate soft warm light onto open writing pages and readable bookshelf books; no obvious visible cones or theatrical bloom. Make the back arched quiet seat a welcoming focal point through a lit paper surface and a small soft olive seat pad on its existing chair. Let one existing near window chair angle outward very slightly as an invitation, preserving clearance. On one existing writing table show a plain notebook opened to a partly written page with no readable personal content, one pen laid neatly alongside and one ceramic tea cup. On a small section of the existing right bookshelf show three face-out book covers with quiet different cloth colors; the rest remains books, not props. Retain the communal table's openness and existing aisle width. Through the left windows retain a modest courtyard with two small trees, restrained low flowers and a small goldfish pond, dusky soft outdoor light, without a forest or extra structures.
Remove all HUD controls and floating interaction labels from the proposal view, leave the cafe branding at the rear intact. At top left put ONLY the small clear Korean label "보완 시안 · 미구현" on a modest ivory caption. No other explanatory captions, no comparison panels, no new slogans.
Mood: a gentle ordinary evening, comfortable enough for 15 minutes of quiet writing after work; the small pleasure of a place waiting for you. Calm rather than dramatic. No people, avatar, candles, religious motifs, incense, timers, achievement badges, purchases, new shops, or excessive decoration.
Invariants: same layout, same table, same windows, same color direction, same stylized render fidelity; this image is a limited design suggestion, not evidence of completed implementation.
